design_notes: Each run uses its own exact permutation cache; per-run distinct evaluations must not be called globally unique across runs.
A second baseline in the parameters stage is an exact rerun with the same seed and sequence.
The initializer is overridden within the diagnostic process only; production engine and formal model are unchanged.
Paired seeds do not imply identical random-number streams after initialization diverges.
All statistical comparisons are exploratory, with 5 seeds and no confirmatory multiple-test correction.
